mission_result.summary: Harvested the minimum implementation-independent specification slice from proven P2/P4 invariants without changing frozen semantics or promoting runtime/product policy into protocol authority.

key_decisions: Freeze bytes and behavioral invariants before APIs.
P2 byte/identity substrate is ready to specify independently of JavaScript.
Only the narrow proven P4 time/order/lineage/transition/checkpoint/archive invariants are harvested.

Do not freeze PX provider/query record shapes, runtime policies, generic persistence/provider APIs, legacy P1 save JSON, concrete multiscale payloads, extension-registry mechanics or current evidence-label vocabulary.
Cross-language conformance should freeze accept/reject outcomes before freezing error-code ABI.
Current version evolution remains exact/fail-closed; no negotiation mechanism is invented.
unresolved_by_design: Language-independent conformance vectors are owned by IND-CONF-A.
External/headless consumer seam is owned by IND-BRIDGE-A.
Generic persistence API and durability are gated downstream.
Public extension namespace governance needs consumer evidence.
Multiscale operation payloads need multiple domain/product consumers.
GATE-G0A-AUDIT must adjudicate the combined sibling outputs.
